body.description: a crawler, a low old-world irrigation robot like a metal crab, a round green-painted body gone rusty, four spindly jointed legs, a rotating sprinkler head on top that spits hot dust, two small amber eye lights; it still crawls dead fields looking for crops to water. no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy

body.action_description: idle: sprinkler head turning, legs shifting
crawling forward on four spindly legs like a crab
